title: 第21章 偷听第22章 只有死人不会泄密
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: 苏芽芽无助地抱住了头。
这种问题为什么又被抬上来了。
但是她精准地感受到要是她否认，半虎兽人好不容易振奋一点的精神会再度消沉。
“我不知道。”苏芽芽低下头，“我们能不能先不说这个事？”
她cpu都要烧干了。
难以应付。
“那你是怎么跟着一起到这里的？”半虎兽人眉头一皱。
“被人骗进来的。”苏芽芽捏紧拳头，声如蚊呐，“我就是想找个工作，然后就被人坑到这里了。”
一想到这件事，她就想把那个骗子揪出来乱刀攮死！
可是从她来到这个地方，根本打听不到一丝这个人的信息。
但凡知道这人的下落，这笔账必须算！
“这个人，我替你找，仇，我替你报。”半虎兽人语气非常诚恳。
苏芽芽苦笑着摇摇头，如果他不是在笼子里，可信度会更高。
可是当她抬眼看到他笃定的双眼。
一丝心虚和愧疚笼上她心头。
“我的事，自己会做。”苏芽芽移开眼，“你的好意我领了。”
这是她来到这个世界之后接受到的为数不多的善意。
“我知道现在这样，你不信我能做到。”半虎兽人敛起眸光，“但是希望你能相信，不论发生什么，我都想帮你，愿意为你做任何你想做的。”
苏芽芽尽管知道这一切都是虚假的。
等他恢复记忆就不复存在。
但是这句话听在耳朵里还是让她眼眶发酸。
“那，”苏芽芽顿了顿，平静了心头那点悸动，“那就请你，今天晚上参加决斗的时候，战胜对手，也保护好自己的性命。”
苏芽芽终于知道为什么行为规范强调管理员不能过多和半兽人交谈。
她是获得了丁管事的特许，才能这样交流。
人与人之间的交谈，会加重情感交流。
此刻她真的不希望他死，希望他能赢，能四肢齐全走下擂台。
为了别人的猎奇心和赌注，死在斗兽场，太不值了。
可是她没有能力改变这种必将走向的结局。
这种无力感让苏芽芽心里犹如堵上了一团棉花。
“决斗？”半虎兽人环视着笼子，目光落在对面的笼子里的半兽人身上。
他的眼睛里闪现过很多情绪。
多得苏芽芽根本分辨不出来。
他会说什么呢？
她又要怎么回答他的新问题？
可是仅仅是几秒钟，半虎兽人好像就消化了现在的处境。
“我知道了。”半虎兽人甚至还能冲苏芽芽笑出来。
苏芽芽不忍看向他的笑容，淡淡道了一声：“你先休息一会吧。”
再聊下去，她内存就要炸了。
她默默地走到角落里去收拾还浸满水的毯子。
没一会儿，光脑传来丁管事的信息：“你立刻到监控室来。”
苏芽芽这才想起这里无时不在的监控。自己居然当着监控说出要报仇的事。
那些人贩子肯定跟斗兽场有勾结。
苏芽芽狠狠掐了一把自己的胳膊，真是笨死了，怎么能不长记性！
“大姐，辛苦你照管一下，管事让我过去一趟。”苏芽芽冲对面大姐喊了一声。
苏芽芽在去的路上，一个劲地回想自己刚说了什么，丁管事要是敲打她，她又该怎么解释。
content_en:
Su Yaya held her head helplessly.
Why is this issue raised again?
But she accurately felt that if she denied it, the half-tiger orc's finally lifted up spirit would become depressed again.
"I don't know." Su Yaya lowered her head, "Can we not talk about this for now?"
Her CPU is about to burn out.
Too difficult to cope with.
"Then how did you get here together?" The half-tiger orc frowned.
"I was tricked into this." Su Yaya clenched her fists and said in a voice like a mosquito, "I just wanted to find a job, and then someone tricked me here."
When she thought about this, she wanted to find out the liar and stab him to death!
But since she came to this place, she has not been able to find out any information about this person.
As long as the whereabouts of this person are known, this account must be settled!
"I will find this person for you, and I will avenge you." The half-tiger orc said in a very sincere tone.
Su Yaya smiled bitterly and shook her head. If he was not in a cage, the credibility would be higher.
But when she looked up and saw his determined eyes.
A trace of guilt and guilt filled her heart.
"I can do my own thing." Su Yaya moved her eyes away, "I accept your kindness."
This is one of the few kindnesses she has received since she came into this world.
"I know that you don't believe that I can do it now." The half-tiger orc narrowed his eyes, "But I hope you can believe that no matter what happens, I want to help you and am willing to do whatever you want for you."
Although Su Yaya knew that all this was false.
It will no longer exist when he regains his memory.
But hearing these words still made her eyes sore.
"Then," Su Yaya paused and calmed down the throbbing in her heart, "Then please, when you participate in the duel tonight, defeat your opponent and protect your own life."
Su Yaya finally understood why the code of conduct emphasized that administrators should not talk to orcs too much.
She had obtained permission from Manager Ding to communicate like this.
Conversations between people will increase emotional communication.
At this moment she really didn't want him to die, she wanted him to win and walk off the ring with all four limbs intact.
It's not worth it to die in the Colosseum for other people's curiosity and bets.
But she had no ability to change this inevitable outcome.
This feeling of powerlessness made Su Yaya feel like a ball of cotton was stuck in her heart.
"Duel?" The half-tiger orc looked around the cage, and his eyes fell on the half-orc in the opposite cage.
There were so many emotions flashing through his eyes.
There were so many that Su Yaya couldn't tell them apart.
What would he say?
How would she answer his new question?
But in just a few seconds, the half-tiger orc seemed to have digested the current situation.
"I know." The half-tiger orc could even smile at Su Yaya.
Su Yaya couldn't bear to look at his smile and said lightly: "You should rest for a while first."
If we continue talking, her memory will explode.
She walked silently to the corner to gather the still-soaked blanket.
After a while, a message from Manager Ding came from the optical brain: "Come to the monitoring room immediately."
Only then did Su Yaya remember the constant surveillance here. He actually said that he wanted to take revenge in front of the surveillance camera.
Those traffickers must be in collusion with the Colosseum.
Su Yaya pinched her arm hard. She was so stupid. How could she not have a long memory?
"Sister, please take care of me. The manager asked me to come over." Su Yaya shouted to the eldest sister opposite.
On the way there, Su Yaya kept thinking about what she had just said, and how she would explain if Manager Ding hit her.
title_en: Chapter 21 Eavesdropping Chapter 22 Only dead people don’t leak secrets
